defect_map.note: what this milestone changed in production behaviour, per defect letter of the task book

D1_readiness_isolation.behaviour: gate_readiness() is pub async and is the only way a lane gets built; a refusal returns Err(PipelineError::NodeNotReady) before the session directory or the event loop exist

D2_state_lifetime.behaviour: a re-pinned block opens a new execution instead of overwriting the recorded one; an emptied pending view after a send keeps tracking and holds the lane

D3_endpoint_truth.behaviour: the submission side declares EndpointKind::Unknown regardless of URL shape; a Recorded endpoint that the configuration forbids is refused at connect; URLs are replaced by rpc-<digest> in answers and in submission records
D3_endpoint_truth.vocabulary_change_is_forward_only: 104 `public_http_rpc` strings in seven committed files predate this round and were left alone; new runs write `unknown`

D4_evidence_gate.behaviour: the expected side is rebuilt from the POLICY const and the production source, never from the artifact the comparison reads

D5_pending_radar_boundary.behaviour: no production behaviour changed: the gate is a scan over 137 files that reports 0 offenders and 0 production radar constructors

The first run used plain `cargo test --workspace`, its default fail-fast stopped the run after the first failing binary, so 46 of the workspace's 117 test binaries and all 16 doc-test targets never executed — an incomplete log is what §10 warns against. --test-threads=1 is unchanged from M12-B because the assembly scratch target/pipeline-tests/ is shared.

d3_red_then_green.what_it_was: a production defect: `without_the_endpoint` did not exist, so a transport error's own text — which quotes the URL it was posting to — was written verbatim into the submission answer, credential and all

my own over-claim, not a defect: the assertion demanded `eth_sendRawTransaction` inside the *read* half's phrase, i.e. it asserted a composition the design does not use. The send phrase names the socket only; the method belongs to the answer text around it
d3_red_then_green.resolution: the method checks moved onto the composed lines (the shared helper asserts `contains(eth_sendRawTransaction)` and `!contains(eth_getTransactionReceipt)` there), and line 514 now asserts the phrase/socket split

d3_url_leak_measurement.method: grep -o 'http://127\.0\.0\.1:[0-9]*' over each run's own log — a count, deliberately not the URL itself, which carried a credential-shaped path segment
d3_url_leak_measurement.post_fix_note: the green run printed no panic message at all, so it printed no line to leak; the standing guarantee is the assertion, not the log: endpoint_provenance.rs:278 and :503 fail if any composed line or evidence row contains the planted credential
d3_url_leak_measurement.stub_url_shape: http://127.0.0.1:{ephemeral port}/token/abc123 — an authority and a path token are both things a submission line must not repeat, and loopback is §5's first bullet made executable: a localhost socket is not automatically labelled local

out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.title: the submission path shares the read path's single retry
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.file_function: crates/chain/src/rpc.rs::request_with (retry loop `for _ in 0..2` at :212), classification in one_attempt (:304)
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.risk: CLASS_SEND_FAILED (:311), CLASS_NON_JSON (:322) and CLASS_HTTP_STATUS (:330) are non-terminal so a POST is repeated; the last two are exactly the shape of 'the node took it and the answer was lost', which means a real broadcast window can double-send the same raw transaction with the same nonce
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.evidence: endpoint-provenance.json `holes_left_open`; no test was written for it because a meaningful test would have to change the submission path itself, which §9 forbids
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.suggested_milestone: first task before M12-E (real-environment validation): split the send retry policy from the read one, and add a negative test that a resend must first check whether the nonce already landed

out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.title: the execution ledger is in-process; nothing replays it
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.risk: a bot restart between send and receipt loses the tracking record, so invariant 4 holds for a node restart but not for a process restart
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.suggested_milestone: M12-E or the first execution-hardening round: a durable, replayable record with a restart test that survives the process, not just the node

out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.title: redaction does not reach a gateway that echoes only the URL path
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.risk: credentials in a path (or a stub that returns just the path) survive into the message; the whole-URL replacement cannot match a path-only echo
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.suggested_milestone: an evidence-shape round: redact by shape, keeping the node's original wording intact wherever it is quoted

out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.title: read-side error strings are not scrubbed
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.risk: a transport error that embeds the endpoint URL flows to stderr untouched; every site reached this round ends in a log line rather than an evidence line
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.suggested_milestone: same round as 3 — the fix class is 'scrub at the boundary', not 'rewrite the node's text'

out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.title: the accepted branch interpolates the node's result value verbatim
out_of_scope_findings_recorded_not_fixed.risk: the result of a send is a hash, so today nothing sensitive can appear; it only becomes a leak if a gateway starts echoing (finding 3)
